approval_quote: 保留 SQLite，明确允许数据库并发和快照差异

exceptions.scope: Writer serialization, lock waiting/timeouts and interleavings that differ from PostgreSQL row-level concurrency
Transaction snapshot visibility and PostgreSQL transaction/snapshot identity semantics

application_rule: Retain both original observations; classify affected cases explicitly with an exception ID. Do not globally ignore status, data or event mismatches. No unimplemented route or missing test is approved.
latest_user_requirement: 功能尽量对齐，要做好并发锁，性能上可以稍微妥协
functional_policy: Implement toward Go parity; explicitly disclose remaining feature differences. No blanket authorization to omit features or mark placeholders complete.

performance_policy.target: Comparable ordinary-use performance with modest measured compromises permitted
performance_policy.threshold: No universal percentage agreed; retain same-condition measurements and disclose regressions
performance_policy.concurrency_correctness: Required; serialization is allowed, lost updates, duplicate claims, broken references and non-atomic rollback are not
